necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and episodes of syncope, raising clinical concern for underlying arrhythmia. Evaluation suggests paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I47.1) and supraventricular tachycardia (I48.0) as potential etiologies for these intermittent symptoms. CPT 93271 is medically necessary to capture rhythm data during symptomatic episodes to guide further management.
